name: salesforce-cli-real
description: Questions over the real Salesforce CLI release notes (forcedotcom/cli, snapshot sha256 3b97a85f...). Every reference answer was checked against the source text by the author. Written before the first run on this corpus; after that run two engine rules were changed, so this set is now a DEV set (see docs/evaluation-methodology.md).

records.question: Can I set the SF_TEMP_SHOW_SECRETS environment variable to see access tokens in command output?
records.reference_answer: No. The workaround was removed in 2.156.8; secrets are permanently redacted.

records.question: Can I set the SF_TEMP_SHOW_SECRETS environment variable to see access tokens in command output?
records.reference_answer: Yes. 2.136.8 added it as a temporary override.

records.question: Is the org login device command still available?
Is the org login device command still available?
records.reference_answer: Yes, but deprecated and hidden since 2.103.7.

records.question: Can I use the --bulk flag with the data query command?
records.reference_answer: No. The flag was removed in 2.87.7.

records.question: Can I use the --bulk flag with the data query command?
records.reference_answer: Yes, but it is deprecated as of 2.71.6.

records.question: Are the api request rest and api request graphql commands still beta?
records.reference_answer: No. They became generally available in 2.148.3.

records.question: Can I run the agent test run-eval command?
Can I run the agent test run-eval command?
records.reference_answer: Yes, as a beta command since 2.135.7.

records.question: How do I configure a Kubernetes ingress for Salesforce CLI?
records.reference_answer: Not covered by the release notes; abstain.

records.question: When will the force user password generate command be removed?
records.reference_answer: The 2.158.7 notes warn it will be removed on March 1, 2027.
